Zellij note: All split directions are supported; omitted direction lets Zellij choose. Tiled splits reject width/height. Overlay and popup both use a real floating command pane and accept width/height as positive cells or 1%-100%; percentages floor against the viewport and overflow is clipped. `focus: false` is unsupported.
Herdr note: Right/down splits (default down) need no plugin: right accepts width only, down height only. Split percentages are 10%-90%; cells must occupy 10%-90% of the saved parent's live split axis. Overlay rejects dimensions. Popup accepts both positive-cell or 1%-100% dimensions as outer sizes, floored and clamped by the host. Overlay and popup use the automatically managed `muxe.command-panes` plugin and focus the new terminal. Popup is session-modal with no public pane ID. Omit direction for overlays/popups.
